hints.title: Distinct Digit Integers
hints.text: An integer is special if every digit in its decimal representation is unique.

hints.title: Shorter Length Counting
hints.text: For integers with length k < len(str(n)), the count is 9 * 9 * 8 * ... for k digits using permutations.

hints.title: Prefix Matching Combinatorics
hints.text: For integers with length equal to len(str(n)), iterate through prefixes. At each position, place smaller unseen digits and choose remaining digits combinatorially.

hints.title: Digit Permutations Implementation

variables: D: number of digits in n (at most 10)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking each number up to 2 * 10^9 takes billions of operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set stores seen digits up to 10 entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines digit DP permutation counting for shorter lengths and prefix matching.
